waypoints.name: Washington Pass Hairpin Turnout
waypoints.note: Park in the large turnout on the SR-20 hairpin switchback just east of Washington Pass; follow the boulder-field climber's trail south toward Kangaroo Pass.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 (North Cascades Highway) to the large turnout at the hairpin switchback just east of Washington Pass, at about 5,100 ft, the same pullout used for the Hairpin and Kangaroo Ridge climbs. The highway closes in winter, so it is reachable only once it opens for the season.

waypoints.name: Kangaroo Temple
waypoints.note: Formation high point near the notch between Kangaroo Temple and Little Finger; Koala Krack is the easiest (5.4) line to the top.
waypoints.directions: Walk south across the boulder field and follow the faint, intermittently cairned climbers' path through forest and talus to Kangaroo Pass, about an hour. From the pass, traverse the on-and-off trail to the gully between Kangaroo Temple and Little Finger and climb it toward the notch, finish one of the face routes, then take Koala Krack, the wide left-trending crack on the summit block, to the top.
